source_policy.uncertainty_rule: Keep null when an exact same-instrument final cannot be independently verified. Never blend observations from different trade dates, sessions or futures contracts.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: TSMC August revenue sets a record as AI demand remains strong
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: TSMC reported August revenue around NT$514.8 billion, up about 53.3% year over year and 10.1% month over month; January-August revenue remained sharply higher.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Confirms leading-edge foundry and advanced-packaging demand remains strong despite rising global yields.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Microsoft-backed d-Matrix adopts NVIDIA NVLink Fusion for inference systems
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: d-Matrix will use NVLink Fusion to integrate its Raptor inference processors into NVIDIA data-center systems, with integrated systems targeted for 2027.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Shows NVIDIA extending its interconnect ecosystem to custom accelerators as AI spending shifts from training toward inference.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Oracle Q1 revenue jumps 30% and backlog reaches $664 billion
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Oracle reported Q1 revenue of $19.3 billion, backlog of $664 billion, raised FY2027 profit guidance to $8.10 per share and expects at least $90 billion annual revenue; it added 850 MW of capacity.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Powerful confirmation of AI-cloud demand, but $28.5 billion quarterly capex highlights financing and execution risk.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Adobe beats Q3 revenue estimates as AI-integrated products gain traction
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Adobe Q3 revenue reached $6.76 billion, above consensus near $6.70 billion; adjusted EPS was about $6.13 and the company raised full-year guidance.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Supports the thesis that generative AI monetization is broadening from hardware and cloud into application software.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AI mega-cap tape becomes sharply selective
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Apple rose 3.56% after its product launch while NVIDIA fell 2.26%; AMD and TSM ADR also finished lower and Microsoft was roughly flat-to-higher.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: High yields are compressing long-duration multiples even as underlying AI demand remains strong, increasing dispersion within technology.

breaking_news.headline: WTI closes at $102.48 and Brent at $107.63 as tanker attacks disrupt supply routes
breaking_news.summary: Oil jumped more than 6% as attacks and disruptions around Hormuz, the Red Sea and Saudi energy infrastructure intensified.
breaking_news.market_impact: Energy inflation is now the dominant macro transmission channel into PPI/CPI, bond yields and equity valuation.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Higher U.S. yields pressure Taiwan technology valuations while shipping and energy-linked themes may outperform relatively.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. stocks fall for a fourth session after August PPI and bond-yield surge
breaking_news.summary: S&P 500 fell 0.58%, Nasdaq 0.65%, Dow 0.60% and Russell 2000 about 1.04%; 10-year Treasury yield approached 4.95%.
breaking_news.market_impact: Markets are repricing higher-for-longer or renewed tightening risk; Reuters cited roughly 70% odds of a Fed hike next week.

breaking_news.headline: ECB raises deposit rate 25 bps to 2.50% as energy shock lifts inflation
breaking_news.summary: The ECB delivered its second hike of the year and raised inflation and growth projections, citing persistent energy-driven inflation from the Iran conflict.
breaking_news.market_impact: Confirms the oil shock is becoming a global monetary-policy issue, not only a U.S. market problem.

breaking_news.headline: Taiwan cash and futures retreat as foreign futures shorts expand
breaking_news.summary: TAIEX closed 46,940.49 (-0.51%); September TX regular session closed 46,870 (-308), near-month OI fell to 94,990 and foreign net OI deteriorated by 2,852 contracts to -83,918.
breaking_news.market_impact: Taiwan cash remains near highs but foreign futures hedging has turned more defensive ahead of U.S. CPI.

earnings_summary.guidance_watch: Oracle Q2 guides revenue growth of 30%-34% and adjusted EPS of $1.85-$1.93; its very high capex remains the key risk. Adobe's raised full-year outlook and AI adoption support software monetization. Kroger reports before the U.S. open on September 11.

narration_points: 今天第一主線是能源衝擊加速：WTI正式結算102.48美元、單日大漲6.69%，Brent收107.63美元，油價已直接推升全球通膨與升息風險。
美股連四天下跌：S&P 500收7591.70、跌0.58%；Nasdaq跌0.65%、Dow跌0.60%、Russell 2000跌約1.04%，風險偏好進一步降溫。
10年期美債殖利率升到約4.943%，盤中逼近4.96%，位於52週區間約98.4%；黃金12月期貨反而跌到4407.30美元，顯示高利率與美元因素壓過部分避險買盤。
8月PPI月增0.4%、年增約5.4%，加上油價衝破100美元，市場對下週Fed再升息的機率推升到約七成；今天晚間CPI成為本週最關鍵數據。
科技內部分化加大。NVIDIA跌2.26%，Apple卻反彈3.56%；AMD與TSM ADR也承壓，說明AI基本面沒有崩，但高殖利率正在迫使資金提高選股門檻。
AI需求仍有硬證據：TSMC 8月營收約5148億元、年增53.3%；Microsoft支持的d-Matrix又採用NVIDIA NVLink Fusion，把AI運算主線從訓練延伸到推論與客製加速器。
Oracle財報是今天最重要的AI CapEx驗證：Q1營收193億美元、年增30%，backlog 6640億美元，並新增850MW容量；但單季285億美元CapEx也讓融資與執行風險升高。
Adobe營收67.6億美元也優於預期，代表生成式AI正在從晶片、雲端逐漸走向軟體變現，AI支出並沒有只集中在硬體。
台股9月10日收46940.49、跌0.51%；台指期日盤46870、跌308點，近月OI降到94990口，但外資淨空擴大2852口至-83918口，籌碼轉保守。
最後看今晚8:30 ET的美國CPI：若能源衝擊開始擴散到核心通膨，10年債可能正式突破5%附近壓力；若核心通膨仍受控，AI強勁基本面才有機會重新主導市場。
